purpose: Determine whether four Maryland psychiatric hospital CCNs can be classified under the Federal/State hospital deemed-compliant provision without attributing a sibling MRF.

federal_rule.text_summary: Federal and State hospitals are deemed by CMS to be in compliance with Part 180, including but not limited to the listed examples. State forensic hospitals exclusively treating individuals in penal custody are a separately listed example, not a condition imposed on all State hospitals.
federal_rule.cms_guidance_summary: CMS states the HPT definition includes state-owned or operated facilities other than those deemed compliant; its description of state forensic hospitals says the specific category is exclusively penal-custody treatment.

state_operator_sources.mdh_facility_roster_observation: Maryland Department of Health's official facilities page categorizes Eastern Shore Hospital Center, Thomas B. Finan Center, Spring Grove Hospital Center and Springfield Hospital Center as Inpatient Psychiatric Hospital Centers.
state_operator_sources.springfield_operator_observation: MDH describes Springfield Hospital Center as a regional psychiatric hospital operated by the Maryland Department of Health.
state_operator_sources.department_context: The remaining facility pages are under the official health.maryland.gov MDH site and the MDH facilities roster identifies the facilities as MDH inpatient psychiatric hospital centers.

cms_enrollment_dataset.query_method: Exact CCN API request; HTTP 200 JSON response; SHA-256 and response byte count recorded before extracting identity fields.

scope_disposition: Four exact CMS enrollment CCNs, organization DBA names and primary practice addresses match distinct MDH-listed inpatient psychiatric hospital centers; CMS organization is the Comptroller of Maryland. Together with official MDH operator context and 45 CFR 180.30(b), this supports an evidence-only state-hospital scope classification for these four records.
no_pricing_claim: No pointer URL, MRF URL, file bytes, price metadata, or rates are asserted. The cached Maryland root pointer remains separately limited to Western Maryland and Deers Head; neither sibling file is assigned to these four CCNs.
next_action: Retain the four as federal scope-exempt under 45 CFR 180.30(b), not as pointer/MRF verified. Revisit if the regulation changes, the State operator/ownership changes, or CMS/state provider identity evidence changes; continue facility-specific MRF discovery only if the tracker retains a separate historical publication or audit objective for these exempt hospitals.
